A DFT search for an eta2-coordinated allenylic carbocation with Pd(0)/(R)-L4 did not locate an optimized structure. This negative theoretical result enriches the existing Figure 1 mechanism record and is not treated as a failed wet-lab reaction.

Two diastereoisomeric eta3-butadienyl palladium intermediates from oxidative addition of racemic alkyl-substituted acetate 1n to Pd/(R)-L4 were investigated by DFT and showed similar C-Pd distances. A mechanism record was created; numerical distances remain unavailable because the cited SI is unassociated.
